Honestly, I think the term "deep web" is applied to Tor, I2P, and other anonymous networks way too often.

Deep web refers to portions of the internet that are not cataloged by search engines. I think this definition is still too narrow -- it should be "not catalogued by anything easily accessible" -- since all the sites people actually frequent on Tor are catalogued.

Dark web or Darknet refers to networks which are anonymous (at least from the perspective of IP addresses and such -- a lot of people assume identities of sorts.)
